title: Completed tab: Earned equals Total minus Adjustments, Remaining $0.00
refs: SV-9282 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S4a-R2 — Completed tab: Earned = Total - Adjustments,Remaining $0.00)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A completed work order that carries a work-order-level fee or discount appears on the Completed tab.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and go to the Completed tab.
2. On a completed work order read Earned, Remaining, Adjustments and Total.
expected:
1. Remaining is $0.00.
2. Earned equals Total minus Adjustments.
3. Total still equals Earned plus Remaining plus Adjustments.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and story SV-9282, and the Work In Progress report specification version 22 (S4a-R2), read on 18 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
